report.summary: Path-aware test selection in large repos uses file-change dependency analysis or ML on historical failures. Google's predictive test selection (ICSE 2017) reported 90% reduction in test time with 0.042% missed failures. Ekstazi (ICSE 2015) achieved ~50% test reduction and 0.2% missed failures in open-source studies. Microsoft's industrial study (Herzig et al., uncertain) saved 87% time with <1% missed failures. Safety depends on training data quality; best systems keep missed failures under 0.1%. Most actionable: adopt a data-driven approach using historical failure data and changed files, val
